android.desc:
Sherlock is an AI face search and reverse image search app that helps you discover visually similar faces, photos, and public web matches using a single image.

Whether you're looking for a similar face, trying an AI face search, or a quick face check to see where a photo shows up online, Sherlock keeps it fast, simple, and private. Some people search for a face finder, others just want to find face matches or run a quick face check. It covers all of that from one photo.

Upload a face photo, take a new picture, or paste an image URL. It analyzes your photo to surface similar faces and images, along with any publicly available social profile matches, wherever they exist, so you get a fuller picture in one place.

KEY FEATURES
- AI face search from a single photo
- Reverse face search across supported public web sources
- Reverse image search using a photo or an image URL
- Search by image from your gallery, camera, files, or a link
- Preview images and match scores for every result
- Open source links directly from your search
- Search history stored locally on your device

HOW SHERLOCK WORKS
1. Upload a face photo or paste an image URL
2. Crop the face you want to search
3. Sherlock runs its AI face search and reverse image search across supported sources, using facial recognition to work as a face detector and line up any facial match it can find
4. Review your matches, ranked by score, with direct source links

Results may include publicly accessible websites, blogs, forums, news pages, image-sharing platforms, and social profile pages from supported public web sources. This can be useful when you want a second opinion on a photo, when you're trying to confirm a profile is genuine, or when you simply want to know more about a picture before you decide what to do with it.

FIND OUT WHERE YOUR PHOTO IS USED
Worried someone might be using your photo without permission? Upload your own picture, and Sherlock AI searches the public web, including social media and other posts, for visually similar faces and matching images. A simple photo lookup to check your digital footprint and catch misuse, like a fake profile built with your photo, before it becomes a problem.

PRIVACY BY DESIGN
It does not build personal profiles or permanently store your photos, keeping things straightforward and private. Search history stays on your device. Every result comes only from supported, publicly available sources, nothing more.
